coverage.evidence: Argument counts per row: chat.limit 0/0 (ChatFitHelpers.cs:20-26), chat.fit 1-2 (ChatFitHelpers.cs:27-33), chat.fit.words 1/1 via OfText (ChatFitHelpers.cs:34-38, ChatRow.cs:79-83), seeded message rows 0/0 (ChatRow.cs:86-91), Read rows 0/0 (ChatRow.cs:94-105), link.mastodon 2/2 (LinkShareHelpers.cs:32-41). Wrong count returns null (ChatNamespaceProvider.cs:67-72), so the token prints as written: raw text when nothing inside rendered, else { + rendered content + } (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46,117-118). Arguments render before the token (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:60-69). Chat data is fetched once per render (ChatData.cs:47-98).

Settings: slow gives Span or off (ChatModeHelpers.cs:38-42); followersOnly gives minutes*60 Span, on or off (ChatModeHelpers.cs:76-79); subOnly and emoteOnly give a flag (ChatModeHelpers.cs:44-45). Span is the largest units (ChatText.cs:37-49,58-64). Pinned gives empty when NotFound (ChatData.cs:165-167, ChatModeHelpers.cs:46-55). Shared names are comma-joined and empty when not in a session (ChatData.cs:170-199, ChatModeHelpers.cs:28-37). isShared comes from the in-memory tracker (ChatData.cs:113-120). A failed Twitch read returns null, so the token prints as written (ChatModeHelpers.cs:69-72). Twitch is read by the broadcaster id whatever the platform (ChatData.cs:146-155). Mentions add @ without doubling, off drops @, soft adds a zero-width space after the first element, /me only on twitch (ChatMentionHelpers.cs:20-57, ChatText.cs:21). length counts text elements (ChatMessageHelpers.cs:25-31, TextArguments.cs:54-60).

Pure and Read rows default to Standard = every context except Viewer (ChatRow.cs:52-53, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22, TemplateHelperContext.cs:18-63): Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook. That matches the intro list, and helpers are absent from viewer text. Viewer Templates is default on (FeatureService.cs:92-99). Message rows use WithTriggerViewerAndDiscord and chat.message.bits uses WithTriggerViewer, so no Timer, and bits has no Discord (ChatMessageHelpers.cs:22,43,46-47, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:32-45). Timer save validation is at TimerManagementService.cs:54. tts.audioconnected is AllContexts (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:215). raw.message is DiscordOnly (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:788).

Message rows read seed 'message' (ChatMessageHelpers.cs:21-40). Chat seeds message, user.bits and user.provider (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1855-1870). Event scoping is by preset: 'message' only in channel.subscription.message and channel.cheer, 'bits' only in cheer (EventResponsePresetCatalog.cs:59-97, TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:153-172). Cheer strips cheermotes (CheerEventHandler.cs:47-56). Discord seeds message for cheer and resubscription (DiscordCheerNotificationHandler.cs:54, DiscordResubscriptionNotificationHandler.cs:57) and a viewer for follow, subscription, gift, resub, cheer and raid. Go-live has no message seed (DiscordGoLiveNotificationHandler.cs:61-67). An event-subscribed webhook gets only event.* variables (OutboundWebhookFanoutHandler.cs:122-150). A pipeline-sent Discord post passes the pipeline variables plus raw.message (SendDiscordNotificationAction.cs:72-79). The mention uses the login when the display name differs (ChatMentionName.cs For).

Limit by user.provider, else twitch (ChatRow.cs:26-29). twitch 500, kick 500, youtube 200 (IOutboundChatShaper.cs:42-44). Text that fits is returned whole. Otherwise the cut is limit minus tail elements plus a tail of ' …' or ' '+end (ChatFitHelpers.cs:41-58). The word cut is the last whitespace before keep, else a hard cut (ChatFitHelpers.cs:61-68). The worked 'the str …' and 'the …' examples follow this. Without fit, the shaper splits at the last space (OutboundChatShaper.cs:93-124).

tts.plain folds by NFKC, removes links (https?:// or www.) and leading @, and drops channel emote codes (TtsTextHelpers.cs:24-36,52-60,81-85). Emote codes are the channel, Twitch global and 7TV/BTTV/FFZ sets (EmoteData.cs:105-125,268-270). keepEmotes passes an empty set (TtsTextHelpers.cs:37). tts.numbers uses whole digits only, not near . or , (TtsTextHelpers.cs:38-42,63-88), in the channel language with English as fallback (TemplateRenderScope.cs:37, NumberCulture.cs:19-30, ChannelSettingsHelpers.cs:32-36). The lexicon is applied by ITtsLexiconService (TtsTextHelpers.cs:43-49, ChatData.cs:123-129). The Pronunciation tab is in tts/i18n/en.json. audioconnected = IsTtsSourceConnected (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:605-611,905-913). TTS Caption is named in i18n/schema/en.json:3110.

x, bluesky and threads prefixes plus Uri.EscapeDataString(text) (LinkShareHelpers.cs:17-31,44-45). Mastodon needs exactly 2 args, a trimmed host containing a dot that passes Uri.CheckHostName == Dns, else null, so it prints as typed. Output is https://{host}/share?text=... (LinkShareHelpers.cs:32-50, ParsedArgument.cs:24). The page samples match the row samples.

reader_answers.evidence: Every helper named exists with that form: chat.message and noCommand (ChatMessageHelpers.cs:21-40), chat.mention.user (ChatMentionHelpers.cs:32), the four settings rows (ChatModeHelpers.cs:38-45), chat.fit with an optional end (ChatFitHelpers.cs:27-33). The nested example is valid because arguments render first (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:60-69).

The surface list matches Standard (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22). Viewer text is excluded (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:18-22). Message helpers have no Timer context and are event-scoped to the presets that seed message (ChatMessageHelpers.cs:22, EventResponsePresetCatalog.cs:59-97). Timer validation is at TimerManagementService.cs:54.
A null render prints as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46,117-118). Missing seeds return null (ChatMessageHelpers.cs:21-40). The fit rules are at ChatFitHelpers.cs:45-68.

noCommand and length (ChatMessageHelpers.cs:23-40). Limit by the trigger provider (ChatRow.cs:26-29, IOutboundChatShaper.cs:42-44). The tail counts toward the limit (ChatFitHelpers.cs:52). Inner helpers render first (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:60-69). Pipes split at parse time from the reply source, not from filled values (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:65-68 renders already-parsed argument lists).
